name: steam-build
description: Æther NW.js desktop shell — Steam build tooling

scripts.prestart: node ensure-sdk.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs win && npm install --prefix app && node strip-parent-link.mjs
scripts.dist:win: node ensure-app-deps.mjs && node strip-parent-link.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs win && node build.mjs win && node postbuild-trim.mjs dist-win && node verify-shipped-steam.mjs dist-win
scripts.dist:linux: node ensure-app-deps.mjs && node strip-parent-link.mjs && node ensure-steam-sdk.mjs && node ensure-node-steam.mjs linux && node build.mjs linux && node postbuild-trim.mjs dist-linux && node verify-shipped-steam.mjs dist-linux
scripts.zip:win: npm run dist:win && node zip-dist.mjs win
scripts.zip:linux: npm run dist:linux && node zip-dist.mjs linux
